observations: Photo 0 shows the back of a silver Canon digital camera with a visible LCD screen displaying an image of trees.
The camera has a central control dial labeled 'FUNC SET' with surrounding buttons for ISO, DISP, MENU, and others.

Text on the front near the lens reads 'CANON ZOOM LENS 4x OPTICAL ZOOM'.
The model name 'PowerShot A550' is visible on the side of the camera in photo 1.
The camera appears to be in used condition with some minor wear and smudges on the body and screen.

claims.evidence: The screen is on and shows an image, but there is no proof of functionality beyond display. No video or live operation is shown. The camera may be powered on but not functional for taking photos or recording.

risks.risk: Camera may not take photos or record video despite screen being on
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the camera turning on, taking a photo, and saving it to memory card, or a live view of the lens capturing motion.

risks.risk: Battery or memory card may be missing or faulty
risks.proof: Photo showing the battery compartment open with battery inserted, or memory card slot with card inserted.

risks.risk: Lens or sensor may be damaged or dirty, affecting image quality
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens and sensor area, or a sample photo taken with the camera.

proof_requests: Video clip showing the camera turning on, taking a photo, and saving it.
Photo of the battery and memory card installed in the camera.
Close-up of the lens and sensor area, and a sample photo taken with the camera.
response.reason: The camera model is identified as Canon PowerShot A550, but the claim of 'working perfectly' is unverified. The screen being on does not confirm full functionality. Hidden risks include non-working internals, missing accessories, or poor image quality. Proof of operation and condition is needed before pricing.
